Class InstanceSorterCardVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.CardVisitor
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.InstancesManager.InstanceSorterCardVisitor
public class InstanceSorterCardVisitor extends CardVisitor
A specialized visitor used during the initialization phase to sort a raw list of parsed cards into structured collections mapped by Era. It also injects the ModifierBuildingsRegistry into specific event cards that require it.
